content.text: Home THE PLAYERS Championship Home of THE PLAYERS Championship 2026 Northeast Florida, home of THE PLAYERS Championship, is a premier spot for your next golf trip.March 10–15, 2026 in Ponte Vedra, Florida The PLAYERS Championship March 10-15, 2026 Ponte Vedra is home to THE PLAYERS Championship, one of the PGA TOUR’s most prestigious and watched events. Witness the incredible competition this year from March 10-15, 2026 at THE PLAYERS Stadium Course at TPC Sawgrass. It's time to plan your visit! What is THE PLAYERS Championship? THE PLAYERS Championship takes place every year and brings thousands of golfers to the area as they compete for one of golf's most sought-after titles. The week-long event is full of incredible matches, exciting events, and more. Get the latest news here. Where is THE PLAYERS Championship 2026? THE PLAYERS Championship will be held at TPC Sawgrass, which is located at 110 Championship Way, Ponte Vedra Beach, FL 32082. The Course THE PLAYERS Stadium Course at TPC Sawgrass is one of Pete Dye’s masterpieces. It was built to challenge professionals and create an exciting experience for spectators. This world-renowned, Par 72, 7,215-yard course is home to one of the most challenging golf holes, the “Island Green” 17, and is the crown jewel of Northeast Florida. It is one of the highest-ranked golf courses in the state and challenges even the sport's toughest players. Family-Friendly Fun at THE PLAYERS Championship Northeast Florida offers plenty of activities for families, making it easy to plan a trip everyone will enjoy. During THE PLAYERS Championship, families can look forward to: Youth Admission Perks: Kids 15 and under get free entry with a ticketed adult (up to two children per adult) from Tuesday to Sunday.Interactive Activities: Check out the Kids Zone and try your hand at a replica of the iconic 17th hole, with proceeds benefiting First Tee - North Florida.Great Food Options: Offering a food experience that brings the best flavors of our region to the table. From classic tournament favorites like burgers and hot dogs to local delights like lobster rolls, Neapolitan-style pizza, and plenty of BBQ. Trucks on 10, Tacos on 12 or grab a delicious, quick-service meal at the Food Court in Stadium Village, conveniently located just steps from the Fan Shop and Nicklaus entrance. Extend the fun beyond the tournament with a visit to Topgolf or Fernandina Beach Golf Club’s Lighthouse Driving Range. Relax at the beach, explore nearby parks, or treat yourself at local breweries, distilleries, and wineries. . Golf resorts such as Sawgrass Marriott Resort & Spa and Omni Amelia Island Resort & Spa offer exciting activities, clubs, and events to keep your little ones occupied. THE PLAYERS Military Appreciation Day Join us on Tuesday, March 10, 2026, as we honor our military heroes during THE PLAYERS Championship. Live Concert: featuring a ceremony on the 17th hole, a concert with a major artist (like Jordan Davis in 2025, Riley Green in 2023), and access to the exclusive Patriots' Outpost lounge.Complimentary & Discounted Tickets: Active duty, retired, reserve, and National Guard members, along with one dependent, receive complimentary tickets on March 10 and 11, plus one competition day (March 12–15). Tickets include a $20 food and beverage voucher. Veterans and one dependent can access discounted tickets with the same benefits. Verification is required online, and availability is limited.Patriots’ Outpost Presented by CSX: Military members can relax in the Patriots’ Outpost, an exclusive lounge near the No. 16 tee, offering complimentary snacks and beverages throughout the week.Fan Shop Discounts: On March 10, active duty, retired, reserve, and National Guard members can enjoy a 20% discount at the PGA TOUR Fan Shop (valid military I.D. required). For more information, discover details on THE PLAYERS Military Appreciation Day here. Frequently Asked Questions What does a Stadium Pass get you at the event? THE PLAYERS Championship's Stadium Pass permits access to the general grounds area and public spaces during the event. Is there a limited amount of days for attendance? Event goers can purchase admission for any day of the event, running from March 10 to 15, 2026. What food is at THE PLAYERS Championship? When approaching THE PLAYERS Welcome Experience, the Food Court invites each visitor with mouthwatering bites from eateries such as Firehouse Subs, Bono's Pit Bar B-Q, Homespun Kitchen, and Tropical Smoothie. Tacos, beer, and pizza are just some of the scrumptious delights that you can find. Is there parking? Yes, there is on-site parking, Tuesday-Sunday, however each day does require a parking pass which you can purchase online. Passes are $20 Tuesday-Wednesday and $50 Thursday-Sunday plus taxes and fees. Parking passes are mobile-only and will not be available for purchase on-site. THE PLAYERS Travel Guide Need help planning your trip to see and possibly play where THE PLAYERS play? Our travel guide is here to help you find the best driving routes and deals available. We’re here to help you make the most of your trip, no matter what time of year you visit.
